description: Read an RSS or Atom feed and return its latest items. When to use: the user wants the latest posts/news from a site that publishes a feed, or you found a feed URL and want headlines plus links. Do not use: to read article text (use web_fetch) or to discover a site's URLs (use web_map). Returns: {ok, url, final_url, title, count, items:[{title, link, published, summary}], cached, took_ms, _metering}. Summary is HTML-stripped and capped at 500 characters. Metered: shares the web free bucket (50 calls/day per IP together with web_fetch), then 1 credit per call over x402 - there is no API key.
name: web_feed
title: Web Feed
